title: The Bone-Truce of Arenthia
summary: Along the northern savannah border between Arenthia and Greenheart, Bosmer truce-elders and Khajiit lunar priests must recover the stolen Bone-Truce Mammoth Tusk before raiders ignite a war.

hook.rumour: The carved Mammoth Tusk that seals the grazing compact between Arenthia's Bosmer hunters and the Moonmont Khajiit vanished from the border cairn last night.
hook.notice: ARENTHIA TRUCE-ELDERS & MOONMONT PRIESTS: Envoys sought to track the missing Bone-Truce Tusk across Reaper's March before border skirmishes break out.

npcs.name: Warden of Arenthia
npcs.greet: The carved Mammoth Tusk that seals the grazing compact between Arenthia's Bosmer hunters and the Moonmont Khajiit vanished from the border cairn last night.
talk: The trouble across Reaper's March began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Arenthia.
If you mean to help the Border-Truce Court of Arenthia, start by checking the trail between Arenthia and Little Ozurs Camp.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Arenthia
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Little Ozurs Camp is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Little Ozurs Camp toward Arara Grove before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Arenthia so Truce-ElderBregor can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Arara Grove
npcs.greet: You made good time from Little Ozurs Camp. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Belwasten Root Tomb.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Belwasten Root Tomb with a picked guard.
Once Belwasten Root Tomb is cleared, return to Arenthia to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Arenthia
npcs.greet: Truce-ElderBregor awaits word on whether the crisis in Reaper's March has been contained.
talk: The elders of Arenthia have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Reaper's March owes you a debt for standing between Arenthia and ruin.
